description.value: Patsara is a Thai restaurant in downtown New Westminster, operating as one of two branches of Patsara Thai Restaurant. The menu spans traditional Thai staples — curries, stir-fries, Pad Thai, and grilled meats — alongside a dedicated vegetarian and vegan section and daily chef's specials. Table reservations and online ordering are both available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through New Westminster.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 66m; stands (8 spaces) at 67m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the New Westminster branch at 528 Carnarvon St with phone 778-398-2777 matching OSM, and confirms the business is actively operating. The OSM email (puvarinchong@gmail.com) differs from the website contact email (patsaraNW1@gmail.com). The website menu explicitly lists a 'Vegetarian/Vegan' section and an 'Order online' link indicating takeout is available; no bike parking, water refill, or Wi-Fi mentions are found anywhere in the content.
concerns: OSM email (puvarinchong@gmail.com) does not match the website contact email for the New Westminster branch (patsaraNW1@gmail.com).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating Thai restaurant with a live website and confirmed address. Useful stop for touring cyclists in New Westminster.
enrichment_extras.notes: Patsara operates two branches: this New Westminster location and a Downtown Vancouver branch at 809 Seymour St. The OSM record correctly identifies the New Westminster branch.
